Table 1: Editing performance of CoT2Edit against baselines on five benchmarks (editing full datasets).

Figure 2: The framework of our proposed CoT2Edit. (I) Construct editing instructions by prompting LLM agents to generate reasoning chains from editing corpora. (II) Generate more instruct data by LLM agents using entity relations from HotpotQA. (III) Train the model via SFT on Phase (I) data to learn targeted response patterns. (IV) Optimize the model using GRPO to enhance generalization on the combined (I)(II) data. (V) Deploy RAG to retrieve relevant edited facts during inference, ensuring accurate question answering.
